items.reason: Four registered EXPERIMENTAL arms (Phase 1 escalation and three Phase 2 cohorts), none acting as a control; the defined value for 'more than one arm but none works as a control' is 'no'. not_applicable is reserved for single-arm trials.

note: GBM eligible only in the closed Phase 1 dose-escalation arm ('Recurrent GBM with confirmed EGFR alterations'); EGFR alteration is required for the GBM patients themselves, so D31-A1 does not apply and EGFR + silevertinib stays candidate-matched (agreed). control_arm_from_other_arms 'no' is consistent with D31-C4.
